description: This file defines custom callback classes for TensorFlow Keras models, specifically for logging training loss after each batch and saving model checkpoints, including handling multi-GPU models.

classes.name: CustomTensorBoard
classes.description: A custom callback extending TensorBoard to log loss after each batch.

classes.name: CustomModelCheckpoint
classes.description: A custom callback extending ModelCheckpoint to save a specific model, handling multi-GPU models and saving best models based on a monitored metric.

methods.name: CustomTensorBoard.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the custom TensorBoard callback with a logging frequency and other keyword arguments.

methods.name: CustomTensorBoard.on_batch_end
methods.description: Logs loss metrics after each batch, according to the specified logging frequency.

methods.name: CustomModelCheckpoint.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the custom ModelCheckpoint with the model to save and other keyword arguments.

methods.name: CustomModelCheckpoint.on_epoch_end
methods.description: Handles saving the model at the end of each epoch, including logic for saving only the best model and handling multi-GPU models.

calls: warnings.warn('Can save best model only with %s available, ' + 'skipping.' % (self.monitor), RuntimeWarning)
